pages.text: It was a hot afternoon. The family worked in the field. Everyone was thirsty.
Lulu brought a big pitcher. "I will make cool lemon water." Mom cut the lemons in half.
Aunt Rosa opened the cupboard wide. "To taste good, it needs a bit of everything!"
She poured in honey. Leaves and flower petals already floated in the pitcher.
"Just one more thing!" She poured in a whole bottle of sweet syrup.
The pitcher brimmed, almost overflowing. The liquid looked thick.
Aunt Rosa tasted it and squeezed her eyes shut. "...Too sweet!"
Lulu filled a fresh pitcher with water, squeezed in only lemon juice, and stirred.
In the field, everyone gulped it down. "So refreshing!"
Aunt Rosa drained a glass too. Then she quietly hid her thick, sweet pitcher behind her.
